definitions.explanation: Someone who supports you or is on your side.
As a suru-verb, to take someone's side.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}の{味方|みかた}だ。
{誰|だれ}も{味方|みかた}してくれなかった。
{敵|てき}か{味方|みかた}かはっきりしてほしい。
examples.english: I want you to make clear whether you're friend or foe.

notes:
ANTONYM:
・{敵|てき} (enemy, foe)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{味方|みかた}になる (to become an ally)
・{味方|みかた}する (to side with)
・{味方|みかた}につく (to take someone's side)
・{敵|てき}か{味方|みかた}か (friend or foe)
・{強|つよ}い{味方|みかた} (strong ally/supporter)

NOTE:
Distinguish from {見方|みかた} (point of view, way of looking at things) which is a homophone with a different meaning.
